tonight.headline: Up 28–1 with eight to play: Saturday changed nothing on your side, and Tate is still questionable
body: Bad news first, and it has not improved. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. Carnell Tate is still questionable with a back after two limited practices, and after a full day of looking there is still no first-hand quote from his coach, only reporters relaying 'good to go'. Saquon Barkley is out and was not put on injured reserve today. ESPN has you ahead 133.6 to 122.3, 56%, which with eight players each to come is close to even.

You lead 28–1 on George Pickens's Thursday night and your lineup is the projection lineup. Nothing needs doing today. Two things about tomorrow: Lawrence, Tuten and the Jaguars' defence kick off in London at 07:30, half an hour after the next brief, and none carries a designation after Saturday's moves; and at 09:30, if Tate is on the inactive list, Golden takes his slot. One small sign in Tate's favour: Tennessee elevated no receiver.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 14.4, Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7, and Tee Higgins, 12.8, in the flex, still questionable with nothing new on Saturday. The Rams' final report lists only a safety. Arizona are trading Marvin Harrison Jr., which touches Love's offence, and Goff plays in Arizona, not Detroit. The Cowboys' defence is banked at 1 (archive).

case.label: Your side
case.body: Pickens 28.0, played. To come: Taylor 19.0, Lawrence 18.1, Wilson 14.8, Tuten 14.0, Tate 13.6, Loveland 9.7, Myers 8.7, the Jaguars 7.7. Every number is the same as this morning's. Lawrence, Tuten and the defence all play at 07:30 on Sunday in London.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tate's name on the inactive list, on your side. On theirs, Higgins sitting, which costs them about a point against their bench. An 11-point projected lead with eight players each to come is close to even.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · check inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: If Tate is inactive: Golden
doFirst.subtitle: Limited on Thursday and Friday and still questionable; reporters relay that his coach says he is good to go, and Tennessee elevated no receiver on Saturday. Do nothing now; Golden plays at the same hour.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Limited on Thursday and Friday with the back and listed questionable (tennesseetitans.com, 9 Oct). Nothing on Saturday changes it. Every account of Robert Saleh's view is a paraphrase of Friday's press conference: the Titans' own Quick Hits has him expecting Tate to be fine, RotoWire (updated 10 Oct 07:12) has him ready to play, NBC's headline is 'good to go'. No first-hand quote about Tate could be found. Tennessee used one elevation, on a defensive back, and none on a receiver (Titans Wire, 10 Oct 16:24 ET), which is a mild sign they expect him.

case.label: Why he stays in
case.body: 13.6 against Golden's 12.8 is a coin flip and coin flips go to the projection. Tate faces Houston, who allow receivers the most points in the league; Golden faces Chicago, fifth-stingiest. A correction to this morning: the National Weather Service has Green Bay sunny, so weather is not an argument against Golden.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Golden is Green Bay's lead receiver, not on the injury report, and kicks off at 11:00 like Tate, so the swap can wait for the inactive list at 09:30.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate is active and Golden outscores him on Sunday (archive): then the coin flip lost, and no thesis was written on it. If Tate is inactive this card fires.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · tennesseetitans.com · RotoWire · Titans Wire · FootballDB · National Weather Service

whatWentWrong.title: Tate is still limited and still questionable
whatWentWrong.lead: Two limited practices on a back he tightened up on Thursday. Saturday brought no update, and his coach's 'good to go' still reaches you only as a paraphrase.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: tennesseetitans.com's final report: limited Thursday, limited Friday, questionable. Saleh's Friday view is relayed by the team's Quick Hits, RotoWire, NBC and ESPN's Turron Davenport, never quoted directly. On Saturday Tennessee elevated a defensive back and no receiver (Titans Wire, 16:24 ET); NFL.com's roundup also lists running back Kalel Mullings, which Titans Wire contradicts. Corner Joshua Williams was downgraded to out.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing yet. The one card stays as a fallback with Golden named, and the decision is made from the inactive list.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: His name on the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday makes Golden the starter. His name missing from it ends the question. Tomorrow's brief comes before that list.

whatWentWrong.sources: tennesseetitans.com · RotoWire · NBC Sports · Titans Wire · NFL.com

Tyreek Hill is still unsigned in anything dated; the newest item is 8 Oct. Checked RotoWire's Chiefs page, FantasyPros and two searches this afternoon. Flags, as answered from Friday's final report and unchanged: OWN_QUESTIONABLE answered: reports lean minor. ROLE_UP answered: 2, 6, 9 targets was a growing role before the injury. Friday's final injury report and this morning's read stand wherever this note does not say otherwise.
report.summary: Bench: Kansas City are on bye. Nothing newer than Tuesday; the hamstring is believed minor and Hill is still unsigned.

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Pickens has played, 28.0 in the flex. Tate is the one conditional starter, questionable with a back and reported good to go; Saturday's moves changed nothing.

contingencies.then: Start Matthew Golden (12.8) in his WR slot

worthALook.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
worthALook.lead: New today, and the biggest riser on your wire: Arizona are trading him and he will be inactive on Sunday. He is a free agent here. The destination is not known, and that is the whole question.

case.label: The news
case.body: Arizona are trading Harrison and he will not play on Sunday (NBC Sports, 10 Oct 15:18 UTC, citing Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport). Bleacher Report's summary of the insiders: Arizona wanted a second-round pick and more, Houston have been in the talks, and the destination may not be announced until after Week 5. He is a free agent in this league, so adding him costs no priority.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 13 targets in four games: 3, 1, 5 and 4, for 4.3, 0.0, 7.0 and 8.2 (archive). ESPN projects 0.0 this week and ranks him 56th. What he becomes depends entirely on a team nobody has named, and he would take a seat from Golden or from a player protected by a teammate's injury.

case.label: When to act
case.body: When the destination is announced. If it is a team with a vacancy at receiver and a quarterback who throws, he is worth a free add ahead of Tuesday's claims, with the drop named then. Until then there is nothing to price.

worthALook.sources: NBC Sports · Bleacher Report · Week 1–4 archive · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Roman Wilson
worthALook.lead: Free, and Pittman went on injured reserve today: out at least four games, back no sooner than Week 10. Wilson's targets did not move the last time he was missing.

case.label: The role
case.body: Pittsburgh put Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) on injured reserve on Saturday (Steelers Depot, 10 Oct 15:52 ET). Heavy expects Wilson and Germie Bernard to take his snaps and targets, a writer's read; no coach has said it. 14 catches for 188 and two touchdowns so far.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Six targets in all four games, the one without Pittman included (archive). 10.3, below Golden on your bench, so he would not start, and heavy rain with gusts to 25 mph is forecast in Pittsburgh. He is a free agent, which matters when you are last in the waiver order.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Indianapolis on Sunday. With Pittman gone for a month that would be a role and not a spike. Even then the seat is the problem: Rice and Barkley are both hurt but neither is out for long.

worthALook.sources: steelers.com · Steelers Depot · CBS · Week 1–4 archive · waiver_analysis.py

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson
worthALook.lead: The highest-projected free tight end, and both Vikings receivers are questionable. The seat is closed and he is off next week.

case.label: The role
case.body: 13 catches on 13 targets for 119 with Jefferson out (archive). Jefferson and Addison are both still questionable on Saturday evening, and Minnesota elevated two receivers, Odell Beckham Jr. and Jeshaun Jones (vikings.com, 10 Oct 15:30), which suggests doubt about at least one. If both sit, Hockenson is Minnesota's first target again.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.4 against Loveland's 9.7 is a coin flip, the seat changed twice on Wednesday, and Minnesota are off in Week 6, which would empty the slot again in five days.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out. Jefferson and Addison both inactive would make it tempting and still a third change at one seat in a week.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · vikings.com · TSN/AP · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: You held him for three hours on Wednesday. Free again, level with Loveland, and not a move.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for a career-high 95 in Week 4 with every Jacksonville pass-catcher healthy (archive; jaguars.com, 10 Oct). Targets 3, 2, 5, 8. No designation for London.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9.7, the same as Loveland, for a seat that changed twice on Wednesday. Jacksonville are off in Week 7; Loveland has no bye until Week 10.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out. Nothing else reopens the seat before 14 Oct.

worthALook.name: Will Shipley
worthALook.lead: The handcuff to your Barkley, who is out and was not put on injured reserve today. Philadelphia's preview has Shipley starting with the heavier workload.

case.label: The role
case.body: Barkley is out for London; Philadelphia's only Saturday moves were two elevations, neither a running back (philadelphiaeagles.com, 10 Oct 16:00). The Eagles' preview (07:30) has Shipley 'likely to get the start and the heavier workload'. ESPN projects Shipley 10.2.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No coach has given a split, and Pierce and Carson Steele are both on the 53. 15 carries all season (archive). 10.2 is below Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, behind a line starting Willie Lampkin, Jake Majors and rookie Markel Bell, and he would be running against your own defence at 07:30 on Sunday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley going on injured reserve. Then the seat question is asked again, and the only unprotected seat is Golden's, who is not a drop for a handcuff.

doNotChase.name: Mike Washington Jr.
doNotChase.lead: Still the second-biggest riser: Jeanty is questionable and Las Vegas raised a running back today. A one-week back you have no slot for.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Ashton Jeanty did not practise on Friday (ankle and foot) and is questionable; Klint Kubiak says he will 'do his best to go'. On Saturday Las Vegas elevated running back Roman Hemby and receiver Deven Thompkins, which Athlon (10 Oct 16:18 ET) and The Big Lead read as a sign Jeanty may sit. That is a writers' reading; no insider has reported his status. Washington would lead, with Dylan Laube and Hemby behind him. A rival in your other league added him this afternoon.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9 carries for 18 in Week 4 and a season-high 21% of the snaps (archive; DraftKings Network). Even as a starter he would sit behind Taylor and Tuten here, your flex has already scored 28.0, and the only seats belong to players protected by a teammate's injury or to Golden.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jeanty ruled out for several weeks. One missed game changes nothing for this roster.

doNotChase.sources: raiders.com · PFT · Athlon · The Big Lead · Week 4 archive

doNotChase.name: Jacoby Brissett
doNotChase.lead: Rising on a matchup, not a role, and he lost a starting receiver today. He still projects half a point under Lawrence.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Detroit have allowed the most points to quarterbacks through Week 4 (FootballDB, re-read 10 Oct) and the game's total is the week's highest, 54.5, with Detroit favoured by 5.5; the game is in Arizona. He is a free agent, so he would cost no priority. Nothing dated this week names Arizona's starter beyond a 5 Oct 'No' to a change.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.6 against Lawrence's 18.1: the projection still prefers the quarterback you have, by a coin flip, and Marvin Harrison Jr. will be inactive on Sunday with a trade pending (NBC Sports, 10 Oct), news that broke after that number was set and can only lower it. The strategy's most expensive mistake was switching quarterbacks on a hunch.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: ESPN moving Brissett above Lawrence by two points or more before 07:30 on Sunday, which this brief will not see; this afternoon the gap is the same 0.5.

doNotChase.sources: FootballDB · CBS · NBC Sports · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Mark Andrews
doNotChase.lead: Lamar Jackson is ruled out. Tyler Huntley throws to him on Sunday night.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The steadiest targets of the free tight ends: 6, 7, 5, 6 (archive). He practised in full on Friday and has no designation.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Lamar Jackson is out and Jesse Minter says of Tyler Huntley: ''Snoop' has done a great job this week... I expect him to play really well' (baltimoreravens.com, 9 Oct 12:46). 9.6, level with Loveland, for a closed seat; Zay Flowers is questionable too.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jackson's return, undetermined for Week 6, together with Loveland being ruled out.

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Steady targets, and a sixth receiver here.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) and tight end Justin Joly are out for Miami (miamidolphins.com, 9 Oct). Five or more targets in every game, 17 catches for 219 on 28 (SportsGrid, 6 Oct; archive targets 8, 5, 10, 5). Nothing dated Saturday mentions him.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 (archive) in an offence that ran 37 plays last week. 11.0, below Wilson, Tate, Pickens and Golden.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Smith and Brown are officially out, which is a real reason. He has not passed six points in a game.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown are ruled out; Dontayvion Wicks has no designation and Dallas Goedert returns, with Zach Ertz elevated as a further tight end (philadelphiaeagles.com, 10 Oct 16:00). One writer rates Wicks a flex start and Lemon a bench player (The Big Lead, 10 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7, with Smith already out; 2.5, 1.9 and 5.9 before that (archive). And he would be catching passes against your own defence.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same eight names clear the tool's bar, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. Saturday firmed up two vacancies, Pittman's and Brooks's, both now on injured reserve, and settled no role. None is a move: you are last in the waiver order and no seat is open.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation with Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal; the Chargers' coach on Friday: 'I don't see any change in terms of the depth chart at all'. Hampton is not on the injury report. Ladd McConkey is still questionable after no practice all week and Quentin Johnston is out; the Chargers put Trey Lance on injured reserve on Saturday. Off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third whose coach says the depth chart has not changed; the trigger is Hampton missing a game

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is not on Atlanta's status report and nothing changed on Saturday. Brian Robinson's 25.7 last week was three touchdowns behind him on 14 carries (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: Green Bay put Chris Brooks on injured reserve on Saturday, out at least four games, and elevated nobody (SI's Packers page, 10 Oct 16:26 ET); Pierre Strong Jr. was signed on 8 Oct and the coordinator says Kaleb Johnson will get more chances. Guards Aaron Banks and Jacob Monk are doubtful. 7 carries for 13 in Week 4 (archive). Josh Jacobs is still on the exempt list. You dropped Lloyd for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — one fewer back behind him, but volume at under two yards a carry behind a line missing two guards
rising.sources: SI Packers On SI · packers.com · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty is questionable after no practice on Friday, and Las Vegas elevated running back Roman Hemby on Saturday, which two writers read as a sign he may sit (Athlon; The Big Lead, 10 Oct). Washington leads if so. 9 carries for 18 in Week 4 (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a one-week starter at most, with no slot here behind Taylor and Tuten
rising.sources: raiders.com · Athlon · The Big Lead · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint (archive). Moore returned to a limited practice on Saturday and is questionable for Monday; Joshua Palmer is out (NBC Sports; Democrat and Chronicle, 10 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting on Monday night, and he practised
rising.sources: NBC Sports · Democrat and Chronicle · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery, as reported on 5 Oct and carried; nothing new was found today. The tool still prints him because his last game was his biggest.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 after DJ Moore left (archive). Moore returned to a limited practice on Saturday and is questionable; Joshua Palmer was ruled out, which leaves Buffalo a receiver short either way.
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out
rising.sources: NBC Sports · Democrat and Chronicle · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Roman Wilson
rising.roleReason: Michael Pittman Jr. went on injured reserve on Saturday, out at least four games (Steelers Depot, 10 Oct 15:52 ET). Wilson was the second receiver when Pittman sat in Week 2 and drew the same six targets he draws every week (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a month-long vacancy now and, so far, a flat six targets; he is free, so waiting costs no priority

settled.title: 'Rain showers are likely at Green Bay' (this morning, used against Golden)
settled.result: The National Weather Service has Green Bay sunny, 75 to 79°F. The morning figure came from a site whose labels and percentages disagreed. The Tate-over-Golden call is the projection's and did not rest on it.

settled.title: 'A downgrade this afternoon makes Golden the starter today' (this morning, on Tate)
settled.result: No downgrade came, and Tennessee elevated no receiver. The fallback card is unchanged and still fires from the inactive list.

settled.title: 'Ladd McConkey doubtful to play' (Friday afternoon, in the Keaton Mitchell note)
settled.result: He is questionable; the doubtful tag belongs to Trey Lance. The game is also Denver at the Chargers, not the reverse. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'Shipley and Pierce expected to share' (Friday afternoon, from the Inquirer)
settled.result: philadelphiaeagles.com, published the same afternoon, expects Shipley 'to be the primary back'. It matters to your Jaguars defence, and the brief used one source when the team's own was available.

settled.title: 'If Tate is inactive: Golden' (Friday's card)
settled.result: Not fired and nothing new: questionable, and reported good to go. The card is carried to Sunday's inactive list.

settled.title: 'Barkley is trending out' (beat writers, relayed since Tuesday)
settled.result: Ruled out on Friday and not placed on injured reserve. He was on your bench at 0.0 all week, with Tuten in his slot.

settled.title: 'One game does not change next week' on Pickens's 13 targets (Friday morning)
settled.result: Lamb's quad is a bruise, not considered serious, and he should play in Week 6 (Rapoport). The caution stands.

settled.title: Pickens in the flex over Golden (a 0.6 coin flip that went to the projection, Thursday)
settled.result: Live archive: 28.0 on 9 catches from 13 targets, 130 yards and a touchdown. Golden plays on Sunday, so the comparison is not finished; no thesis was written on it either way.

settled.title: 'Put in the claim for George Pickens' (Wednesday's first card)
settled.result: It won, cost the priority, 7th to 10th, and his first game for you scored 28.0. Graded over Weeks 5 to 7 against Downs, who plays on Sunday. One game; the log entry stays open.

settled.title: 'Nobody has explained Tate's back' (Thursday afternoon)
settled.result: It was explainable within hours: a beat writer watched him tweak it in individual drills. The brief did not find that on Thursday.

settled.title: 'Start Tuten in the RB slot, not Gordon' (Tuesday, Wednesday twice, Thursday)
settled.result: Done at 08:44 on Thursday. 14.0 against 10.9; graded on Sunday against Gordon's score.

settled.title: 'You are 7th of ten, so it will probably fail' (Wednesday's edition)
settled.result: It did not fail. Six managers ahead of you passed on a receiver 99% rostered. The forecast was wrong; the recommendation stood either way.

settled.title: 'Swap the Ravens' defence for the Jaguars', free' (Tuesday's and Wednesday morning's card)
settled.result: Done at 12:40 on Wednesday. 4.9 out, 7.7 in. Graded on Sunday against the Ravens' score.

settled.title: 'Strange first, Loveland second' (Wednesday morning's order)
settled.result: You swapped Strange for Loveland at 13:06 on Wednesday. Both project 9.7. Graded on Sunday: the order is wrong if Loveland outscores Strange, and the second move was churn either way.

settled.title: Week 4 final: 63.7 to 78.2
settled.result: Kyle Pitts added 7.7 for Team 13 on Monday (archive). You lost by 14.5. Kamara 22.8, Tate 21.5, Gordon 18.0 and Golden 11.7 on the bench would have scored 61.7 more than the four slots they could have filled. Barkley and Rice were injury exits; the rest was the projection's lineup.

settled.title: Downs in the flex (the projection lineup, 13.6 to Tate's 11.9)
settled.result: Archive: Downs 4.6, Tate 21.5. A coin flip by projection with no thesis written, and it lost by 16.9.

settled.title: 'Darren Waller: do not chase' (Saturday's brief)
settled.result: You added him. Archive: Waller 6.6, Sadiq 0.0. Your move won the week; four days later you dropped him on his bye.

settled.title: 'Gordon: bench, leaning against the claim' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Archive: 18.0 on the bench. The lean was mine and it is withdrawn. He projects 10.9 this week and is on your bench behind Tuten, where the projection puts him.

cannotSee.label: Sunday's inactive lists
cannotSee.body: Jacksonville and Philadelphia kick off at 07:30 Mexico City, so their inactives are out by 06:00, before tomorrow's brief. Tate's come at 09:30, after it. The one card is written to be fired from that list, by you.

cannotSee.label: Tate's back
cannotSee.body: After a second day of looking there is still no first-hand quote from Saleh about Tate; 'good to go', 'fine' and 'ready to play' are all reporters' paraphrases of Friday. Whether Tennessee elevated a second player is disputed between NFL.com and Titans Wire; neither says a receiver.

cannotSee.label: Philadelphia's backfield
cannotSee.body: The Eagles' site has Shipley starting with the heavier workload; no coach has given a split and no back was elevated. It matters to your Jaguars defence more than to your bench.

cannotSee.label: Harrison's destination
cannotSee.body: Unknown, and possibly unannounced until after Sunday. Everything about his value follows from it.

cannotSee.label: Who starts at quarterback
cannotSee.body: Lawrence, Hurts and Bagent are confirmed by dated reports. Daniel Jones, Geno Smith, Cam Ward, Jordan Love and Malik Willis are confirmed only by being off the injury report and named in previews; nothing contradicts any of them.

cannotSee.label: Why Pickens drew 13
cannotSee.body: No Cowboys coach or Prescott was quoted on his role. Lamb's quad is a bruise by two accounts; his Week 6 status has not been given.

cannotSee.label: Rice and Tyreek Hill
cannotSee.body: No scan grade for Rice and nothing dated after 6 Oct. Hill is unsigned in anything dated; the newest item is 8 Oct.

cannotSee.label: Green Bay's backfield and line
cannotSee.body: No page names the lead back outright; Lloyd first with Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong behind him is the reading. Two guards are doubtful, which touches Golden. Jacobs is still on the exempt list with no date.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: FootballDB's PPR table, Weeks 1 to 4, read by a research pass through a page-summarising tool; Thursday's game is not in it and ties are common. Two ranks differ from this morning by a place because of how ties are counted; no tile changed colour. Defence and kicker tiles lean on CBS's consensus; 4for4, Draft Sharks and FantasyPros would not open.

cannotSee.label: Betting lines and weather
cannotSee.body: No page showed Friday's numbers, so day-to-day moves cannot be stated. Pittsburgh is the wet game on your roster: showers certain, gusts to 25 mph. The East Rutherford forecast carried a Friday-evening stamp.

cannotSee.label: Quotes
cannotSee.body: Every page was read through a summarising tool by a research pass, so quotations are close but may not be exact. Search returns headlines from several seasons at once; nothing here rests on a headline alone.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: It reads this week's live archive, which holds only Thursday night's game, so it is still dominated by Buccaneers and Cowboys. Pass 2, with Slayton, Palmer, Harrison, Charles and Lance added to the confirmed-out list, returned the same eleven names, so nobody new was researched and every verdict is carried. Sean Tucker, KaVontae Turpin and Kendre Miller are not on the published wire.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN shows only your own. You are last in the order, so any claim of yours loses to any rival's; free agents cost nothing. Kenny Gainwell, Jake Ferguson and Cade Otton are on waivers until 01:00 on Wednesday.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Barkley and Rice have no timetables, so nothing can be priced.
